verdict.rationale: Stripe docs mention customizing a card program including 'network and card product type' ([stripe-issuing-docs-22]), implying support for varied card products, but no evidence explicitly confirms distinct debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs. Community discussion raises unresolved questions about whether cards are prepaid vs. credit/debit, adding uncertainty rather than contradiction ([stripe-issuing-comm-1],[stripe-issuing-comm-2]). Missing for 10: explicit documentation enumerating debit/prepaid/commercial-credit/consumer-credit program types, and confirmation of underwriting/funding differences for credit vs prepaid rails.
